.premium-select:focus-visible, .premium-select[data-state="open"] { border-color: var(--foreground); box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--foreground) 8%, transparent); }
.premium-select-menu { border-radius: 8px; box-shadow: var(--shadow-refined); max-width: calc(100vw - 32px); background: var(--popover); }
.premium-select-menu [role="option"] { min-height: 44px; margin-block: 2px; padding-inline: 12px 32px; border-radius: 4px; cursor: pointer; transition: background 140ms ease; }

.site-header { left: 20px; right: 20px; max-width: 1280px; margin-inline: auto; border-radius: 999px; background: var(--glass-navigation); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(140%); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink-foreground) 14%, transparent); box-shadow: var(--shadow-navigation); transition: background 350ms ease, box-shadow 350ms ease, border-color 350ms ease; }

.site-header[data-scrolled="true"] { background: var(--glass-navigation); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(140%); border-color: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink-foreground) 16%, transparent); box-shadow: var(--shadow-navigation); }

.mobile-dock { left: 20px; right: 20px; bottom: max(12px, env(safe-area-inset-bottom)); border-radius: 24px; overflow: hidden; border: 1px solid var(--glass-light-border); background: var(--glass-dock); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(140%); box-shadow: var(--shadow-navigation); transition: background 350ms ease; }

.mobile-menu { inset: 12px 20px auto; max-height: calc(100svh - 24px); overflow-y: auto; border-radius: 28px; border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink-foreground) 18%, transparent); box-shadow: var(--shadow-navigation); background: var(--glass-menu); backdrop-filter: blur(28px) saturate(130%); }
.glass-control, .glass-tile { background: var(--glass-surface); border: 1px solid var(--glass-light-border); backdrop-filter: blur(16px) saturate(130%); box-shadow: var(--shadow-refined); }

.glass-action, .story-caption { background: var(--glass-dark-surface); border: 1px solid color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink-foreground) 30%, transparent); backdrop-filter: blur(20px) saturate(130%); box-shadow: var(--shadow-refined); }
.safe-carousel { display: flex; gap: 16px; overflow-x: auto; scroll-snap-type: x mandatory; margin-inline: max(20px, calc((100% - 1216px) / 2)); padding-block: 4px 20px; }
[data-motion-ready] [data-reveal] { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(34px); transition: opacity 850ms ease, transform 1000ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.65, 0.2, 1); }
[data-motion-ready] [data-reveal="stagger"] > * { opacity: 0; transform: translateY(30px); transition: opacity 700ms ease, transform 850ms cubic-bezier(0.2, 0.65, 0.2, 1); }
.story-stage { position: sticky; top: 0; height: 94svh; min-height: 680px; overflow: hidden; background: var(--muted); }
.story-intro, .story-second, .story-third { position: absolute; inset: 0; max-width: 1280px; margin-inline: auto; padding: 110px 32px 80px; }

.story-intro { display: grid; grid-template-columns: 1fr 1.1fr; align-items: center; gap: 64px; opacity: var(--intro-opacity); transform: translateY(calc(var(--story-progress) * -100px)); visibility: visible; }
.story-second { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; opacity: var(--scene-opacity); transform: translateY(calc((1 - var(--scene-opacity)) * 40px)); }
.story-third { display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; opacity: var(--third-opacity); transform: translateY(calc((1 - var(--third-opacity)) * 30px)); }

.story-search-return { position: absolute; z-index: 5; right: max(20px, calc((100% - 1216px) / 2)); top: 178px; height: 44px; background: var(--glass-navigation); border-color: var(--glass-light-border); backdrop-filter: blur(20px); opacity: 0; visibility: hidden; transition: opacity 250ms ease; }
.immersive-search { background: var(--glass-dock); border-color: var(--glass-light-border); backdrop-filter: blur(24px) saturate(130%); }

.story-progress-track { position: absolute; bottom: 30px; left: max(20px, calc((100% - 1216px) / 2)); right: max(20px, calc((100% - 1216px) / 2)); height: 1px; background: color-mix(in oklch, var(--ink-foreground) 30%, transparent); }

.story-scroll-cue { display: flex; position: absolute; bottom: calc(var(--dock-clearance) + 14px); left: 20px; right: 20px; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 8px; font-size: 11px; text-shadow: var(--shadow-navigation); pointer-events: none; }
.story-intro { padding-top: 92px; gap: 14px; align-content: start; overflow-y: auto; }
